description: This file extends the OnboardingView with a wizardPage() method that provides a guided onboarding wizard UI component. It also defines a private struct OnboardingWizardCardContent responsible for displaying the current state of the onboarding wizard, including error handling, progress, current step, and completion states.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardCardContent
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays the current state of the onboarding wizard, including errors, progress, current step, completion message, and waiting state.

methods.name: wizardPage
methods.description: Provides a SwiftUI View that contains the onboarding wizard page, including title, description, and the wizard card content.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI layout for the wizard card content, displaying different UI elements based on the wizard's current state.
